scope: Current source entrypoints and existing architecture/test evidence. Not an exhaustive dynamic-loading or import-closure audit.

findings.expected_behavior: While supervising children, the manager retains an exclusive lifetime lease and the control channel; a new manager does not adopt existing processes without validated transfer.
findings.actual_evidence: At 2026-10-27 approximately 17:51 +05:30, PID 6943 remained parent of four recorded services whose recorded process identities matched, while manager.lease and manager.sock and matching descriptors were absent. Four expected loopback listener owners remained present.
findings.missing_connection_or_contract: The live runtime state is inconsistent with the current source ownership contract. Cause and loaded source version are unknown; no supported adoption/handoff is available.
findings.user_visible_impact: Manager control and recovery ownership cannot be safely reconciled; helper restart/control requests cannot be proven to reach the running supervisor through the expected socket.
findings.smallest_safe_fix: No live fix in this mission. Require the original manager terminal and an explicitly authorized maintenance procedure. A future cooperative, versioned owner handoff is a separate design and implementation.

findings.component: Local authentication helper, gateway, CRE status, scene gallery, and dashboard
findings.expected_behavior: Private local unlock establishes an authenticated WebSocket; current backend status and owner-filtered persisted CRE artifacts render with freshness, errors, hashes, and stale indicators.
findings.actual_evidence: The normal unlock dialog was visible in the earlier shared browser session. The operator was unavailable; no authenticated browser request, persisted image decode, live owner-isolation test, or current CRE response was observed.
findings.missing_connection_or_contract: Live authenticated response-to-render data flow and current evidence/hash agreement are unverified, not shown to be disconnected.
findings.user_visible_impact: No defensible live claim can be made about current CRE status, scene gallery, freshness, or owner-isolation behavior.
findings.smallest_safe_fix: No source change indicated. Have an operator unlock privately and complete the non-mutating procedure in docs/ULTRON_AUTHENTICATED_VERIFICATION_RUNBOOK.md; use an authorized second principal or supported fixture for isolation.

findings.expected_behavior: An explicitly reviewed file allowlist and reproducible dependency set produce a checksummed release that can be restored and qualified as rollback.
findings.actual_evidence: The bundle tool requires a caller-supplied allowlist. Root requirements are not a full resolved lock, no approved allowlist or complete file closure exists, and no known-good archive/rollback artifact was established.
findings.missing_connection_or_contract: No evidence binds all runtime source/assets/dependencies to one approved release identity.
findings.user_visible_impact: Deployment and rollback cannot be validated.
findings.smallest_safe_fix: Complete runtime/import/config/schema closure and dependency resolution, obtain license approval, approve an exact allowlist, then build/verify/restore a separate bundle and preserve its independent checksum/test evidence.

findings.expected_behavior: PDF ingestion/analysis dependency and license are approved for the intended deployment/distribution.
findings.actual_evidence: Three direct PyMuPDF/fitz usages and root requirement are present. Upstream documents AGPL and commercial licensing alternatives; no organizational decision is recorded.
findings.missing_connection_or_contract: Legal/compliance decision and approved version/lock are absent.
findings.user_visible_impact: Release scope cannot be cleared for deployment; learning PDF functionality must not be silently removed or replaced.
findings.smallest_safe_fix: Obtain documented AGPL compliance approval or Artifex commercial-license approval; then record/pin the approved dependency.

findings.expected_behavior: Advisory applicability is assessed against the exact package version and reachable model-loading path.
findings.actual_evidence: Reference lock and package metadata show 4.57.6; OSV CVE-2026-5241 lists version 5.2.0 and describes LightGlue nested-config remote-code execution. The managed voice service explicitly selects Edge. No LightGlue or AutoModel.from_pretrained call was found in the reviewed managed voice/application files.
findings.missing_connection_or_contract: No exhaustive audit of every reference-staging script or downloaded model workflow was completed.
findings.user_visible_impact: Do not report confirmed exposure or declare the optional environment safe until its actual execution paths are inventoried.
findings.smallest_safe_fix: Correct the earlier scanner statement that 4.57.6 is confirmed affected; trace reference-staging model loaders and rescan the exact deployed environment before disposition.
